commit.message:
PUNIT: unpin PUnit, remove the isUnitLikeTy special case

`PUnit` is no longer a pinned basis block: it installs through the
uniform installer like any stream inductive, and unit-η at it is
`structUnitCert` (`caps.unitlike`), η/the stuck-major rescue the generic
`structEtaCertWith`.  Deleted: `Kernel/Basis/PUnit.lean`, the three
reserved names, `BasisKind.punitK`, `isUnitLikeTy`/`isUnitLikeTyC`,
`proofIrrel`'s unit-like arm (and its now-unused env argument), the
0-field PUnit rescue arm, `DefEq.unitLike`, `unitLike_eq_punit`
(`Verify/PinnedShapes.lean`), the P-tier PUnit basis proofs, `punitLfp`,
`BConst.punitRec`/`punitRecV`.  PUnit leaves the built-in prelude
(pins regenerated on all three pinners).  The two `_nomodel` collide
fixtures, which used PUnit without declaring it, now declare it
(`scripts/splice_prelude_block.py`); new corner fixtures
`corner_punit_own` (was 1, official 0) and `corner_punit_unit_eta`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

UNIFCHK: official's uniform-occurrence check (nestUniform) before the positivity check; M2′ and M3 root lines deleted

nestUniform (Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean): every stored constructor's
member abstraction at the canonical parameters has every member applied to
them (holesApplied) and member-free parameter domains — official's
check_uniform_ind_occs, run before the walk.  One local check in the container
case (nestCont): a container instance's parameters pass holesApplied.
nestNoMemberConst (M2′) and nestRootLines(All) (M3) are gone; their consumers
keep their statements: M2′ from nestUniform (nestAbstract_nestOcc_zero), the
normal forms' holesApplied by induction over the positivity derivation
(posD_holesApplied, Verify/Inductives/HolesApplied.lean).

Moves (all to official's verdict): corner_nestind_d_redex_bad 0→1,
corner_simpd_order_decline 2→1, uh_root_beta_param/uh_root_erase_nonunif/
uh_param_domain 0→1 (new fixtures, with the controls uh_root_erase_unif,
uh_nest_key_{redex,erase} 0 and uh_nest_key_beta_param 1).  Reported
accepted superset: uh_let_erase_{type,value} (official 1, ours 0; the check
reads the stored, ζ-reduced type).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

SIMPAD-F: the positivity walk's container memo (NestState.ctorsOf, nestContainerC) deleted

A container's constructors are now a by-name lookup (IndCaps.ctors), so the
per-block memo of the old environment scan no longer pays: init-full and
c05b measured with the lookup unmemoised are within noise of the memoised
run.  nestGroupCtors becomes stateless; the state invariants lose their
lookup clause (DerivCache, NfStScoped, RInv) and NestStOk is gone with the
hpos threading through the cached stage (BlockRunC, GenRecC).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

SIMPD: the root frame walks each constructor at its own input-derived fuel (today's)

nestCtors' walk is indexed by the constructor's instantiated type: a
container frame's is its enclosing walk (fuel one lower), the root's is
fueled per constructor (whnfWalkFuel of its crest), as the member walk
was — no verdict moves on fuel.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

SIMPD: the member block is the positivity check's ROOT frame

Kernel: one hole rule (nestHoleAt: the root frame's entries, then the
frames), one constructor loop (nestCtors, returning each constructor's
kinds and normal form; the root is nestRoot), one table writer
(nestCtorNf, the root's entries recorded like every frame's); U2's typing
is the root frame's constructor typing; the root's own lines are M3/M2'
(nestRootLines) and the fields' universes at the holes
(checkAbsCtorSorts).  Deleted: nestMemberCtor(s), nestBlockCtors,
nestMemberNfs, checkAbsCtorTys(All); checkBlockSeeds and targetRecCheck
lose the members' normal forms.

Proofs: the root's derivation is the frame's (PosD .ctors at the root
key, nestRoot_deriv); MemberCtorD read off it (NestRootOk:
the member holes read by the frames' rule); the members' table entries
recorded by the frames' CtorsRec (CtorsRecRoot, rootEntry_mem).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

RPFOLLOW 1: PosKind unified into NestFieldKind (the run's kind is the derivation's)

The declarative PosKind was NestFieldKind constructor for constructor and
NestFieldKind.erase a relabelling. Deleted both; the derivation (PosD,
MemberCtorD, the model) now carries the run's NestFieldKind directly;
PosKind.guarded becomes NestFieldKind.guarded (proof side), PosKind.flat is
the kernel's NestFieldKind.flat. The erase transport lemmas (erase_getD,
erase_getD_bne, getD_erase, guarded_erase) are gone. Proof-only.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

RPCLEAN: the in-progress test reads only `active` (frame-stack test dropped, coverage proved)

nestContKey's `prog.any (·.key == key)` disjunct is implied by
`st.active.contains key`: every frame-stack entry is a key of an enclosing
nestContNew's group, pushed to `active` for its frame.  Complete/ProgActive.lean
keeps the older walk as a spec (nestContKeyP/nestContP/nestPosP) and proves it
equal to nestPos wherever the frame stack is in progress (nestPosP_eq; at the
walk's entries nestPosP_eq_nil).  PosDR's frame-stack freshness premise dropped.

SEEDDEFEQ M1: seed the positivity check with the recursors' outside majors; the syntactic pass deleted

The recursor check's majors (the stream's list of classes) seed the
positivity check: before the recursor stage, every recursor's outside
major is read in the walk's representation (nestSeedKey?, members
abstracted, parameters at the canonical variables, annotated) and walked
at the root like a container instance (nestSeeds -> nestContKey).  The
syntactic pass (nestSynApp?..nestSyn) is deleted with its derivation
rules (PosD.synNil/synNew/synHit -> one PosD.seed), inversions, bridges,
cached twin, the subterm-denotation file PosDerivSem, and the parked
completeness lib's syn cases.  The node tie now reads NodeAtCtor or
NodeAtSeed; seed forests join the node list (nestedRecCtx_nodes); a
seed's key is read in the hole context by its leaves
(blockHoleCtx_canon, factored out of blockWalkCtx) and K.52.
